snippet.title: Brain Genius by Glu - Free Mobile Game Demo
snippet.description:
Play it now at http://mplayit.com/#Braingenius

Forget the gym, start exercising your brain with Brain Genius, the best brain training game on mobile! Glu builds and expands on the popular and successful Brain Training phenomenon. Measure yourself against famous geniuses throughout history or compete with your closest friends.
